residual_limits: Own fixtures do not prove root process metadata visibility, root staging permissions, Seize/capture/release or actual driver return on this Mac.
Native calls remain cooperatively bounded only; a blocked IOKit syscall cannot be safely cancelled. No kill, reset or automatic retry is implemented.
SDK capture excludes mass-storage driver termination; if MSC remains associated, native flow aborts before interface claim, returns and reports observed or UNKNOWN state. Success is not assumed.

Native helper rejects mounted or unknown media before capture and again before claim; user must manually eject all FX3 volumes while leaving MSC connected. No automatic unmount or configuration/reset fallback.
Recorded observer proves current PID incarnation or confirmed absence and receipt consistency only. It does not prove independent driver functionality or camera recovery.

Root staging and immutable lease create task records under /private/var/root/fx3-owner-trials and a fixed internal private temporary frame directory. No daemon, driver, login item or reusable root executor is installed.
Backup, actual restore/readback, independent rescue, actual target HEVC recording and persistent package remain unproven and unreleased.
